text: Illustration. A different car, April 20th account
In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
observed: Option A 15.0 to 15.8 s. The car edges into the brown water with growing splash. At 15.4 s the view is from higher: far bank with a tree and pale ledge at top, car in the water on the right. By 15.8 s the car has rotated about twenty degrees, drawn larger, a dark shadow appears offset under its lower edge and a pale trailing line extends to its left. Car lower corner is just above the caption box top; caption does not cover the car.
